overview_description.description: Vedantu provides students with LIVE online master classes and personalized one-to-one tutoring for school boards and competitive exams. The platform offers educational courses and study materials across science, math, coding, and English for various age groups. Vedantu also operates offline centers for students focused on cracking competitive entrance exams like JEE and NEET.

product.description: Scheduled live online classes focused on exam preparation and subject mastery for various academic boards and competitive exams.

product.name: HC Verma Solutions
product.description: Comprehensive solutions and explanations for the HC Verma physics textbooks used by students preparing for board and competitive exams.

product.name: NCERT Solutions
product.description: Chapter-wise solved answers for NCERT textbooks across all classes and subjects, aligned with CBSE curriculum.

product.name: Previous Year Question Papers
product.description: A collection of past exam papers with solutions for various boards and competitive exams to aid student exam preparation.

product.name: Question & Answer Platform
product.description: An online service where students can post academic questions and receive expert answers across various subjects and grades.
